Each case study starts from one narrow question that public data can answer well. Below are the
questions we may take up next, ours and those suggested by readers. **Vote for the ones you would
like us to answer**, or suggest a new one. Votes help us choose between questions of similar
quality; they do not decide on their own whether a question is feasible. Reader questions are
listed only after we have reviewed them, in our wording, and stay listed for up to 90 days.

```{=html}
<div class="rq-toolbar" role="group" aria-label="Show questions">
  <button type="button" class="rq-filter active" data-src="all">All</button>
  <button type="button" class="rq-filter" data-src="ours">Ours</button>
  <button type="button" class="rq-filter" data-src="reader">From readers</button>
  <span class="rq-count" id="rq-shown"></span>
</div>
<div class="rq-scroll">
  <table class="table rq-table" id="rq-all">
    <thead><tr><th>Question</th><th>Region</th><th>Source</th><th class="rq-num">Votes</th><th></th></tr></thead>
    <tbody></tbody>
  </table>
</div>
<div id="rq-check" class="rq-check"></div>
<div id="rq-vote-msg" class="rq-msg" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
```

## Suggest a question

We take short, specific questions on agri-food, water, climate and rural policy, for example
*"Do El Niño years cut rice output in Southeast Asia more than an average bad year?"* We read
every question, but we cannot take up all of them. Those that fit our scope and that public data
can answer well may be listed above, in our wording, and some may become case studies, tagged
*Reader questions*.

**We don't reply individually, and we don't collect contact details.** To see every new case
study, including any answer to your question, follow
<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/mithril-metrics">Mithril Metrics on LinkedIn</a> and
turn on notifications, or subscribe to our <a href="index.xml">RSS feed</a>.

```{=html}
<form id="rq-form" class="rq-form" novalidate>
  <label for="rq-text" class="form-label">Your question</label>
  <textarea id="rq-text" class="form-control" rows="3" maxlength="300"
    placeholder="One question, one sentence if possible"></textarea>
  <div class="rq-help"><span id="rq-count">0</span>/300 characters · no links</div>
  <label for="rq-region" class="form-label mt-2">Region (optional)</label>
  <select id="rq-region" class="form-select">
    <option value="">Any or several</option>
    <option>EU</option><option>Sub-Saharan Africa</option><option>South Asia</option>
    <option>Southeast Asia</option><option>Latin America</option><option>Global</option>
  </select>
  <div class="rq-hp" aria-hidden="true">
    <label for="rq-website">Leave this empty</label>
    <input id="rq-website" type="text" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off">
  </div>
  <label class="rq-consent" for="rq-consent">
    <input type="checkbox" id="rq-consent">
    <span>I agree that Mithril Metrics may edit, shorten or reword my question, use it for an
    analysis, and publish it, in its own wording, on this site and its channels (such as
    LinkedIn) together with any answer. My question contains no names, personal or confidential
    information.</span>
  </label>
  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" id="rq-send" disabled>Send question</button>
  <div id="rq-msg" class="rq-msg" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
</form>
```

```{=html}
<style>
.rq-preview-banner { background:#fff4d6; border:1px solid #e8c868; border-radius:6px;
  padding:.6rem .9rem; margin-bottom:1.2rem; font-size:.95rem; }
.rq-toolbar { display:flex; gap:.4rem; align-items:center; margin:1.2rem 0 .5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.rq-filter { border:1px solid #cfd6dd; background:#fff; border-radius:999px; padding:.15rem .8rem;
  font-size:.88rem; color:#3d4a56; cursor:pointer; }
.rq-filter.active { background:#1f2a33; border-color:#1f2a33; color:#fff; }
.rq-count { margin-left:auto; font-size:.85rem; color:#5b6876; }
.rq-scroll { max-height: 26rem; overflow-y:auto; border:1px solid #e3e8ec; border-radius:6px; }
.rq-table { margin-bottom:0; }
.rq-table thead th { position:sticky; top:0; background:#fff; z-index:1; box-shadow:0 1px 0 #e3e8ec; }
.rq-table td, .rq-table th { vertical-align: middle; }
.rq-table .rq-num { text-align:right; width:4.5rem; }
.rq-table td.rq-num { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.rq-region { white-space: nowrap; color:#5b6876; font-size:.92rem; }
.rq-src span { display:inline-block; font-size:.75rem; border-radius:3px; padding:0 .35rem; white-space:nowrap; }
.rq-src .ours { background:#eef2f5; color:#3d4a56; }
.rq-src .reader { background:#e6f4f1; color:#0f6b5c; }
.rq-days { display:block; font-size:.72rem; color:#5b6876; margin-top:.15rem; }
.rq-vote { white-space: nowrap; width:6.5rem; text-align:right; }
.rq-vote button { font-size:.85rem; padding:.15rem .6rem; min-width:4.6rem; }
.rq-check { margin:.6rem 0 0; }
.rq-form { max-width: 560px; }
.rq-help { font-size:.85rem; color:#5b6876; margin-top:.2rem; }
.rq-hp { position:absolute; left:-10000px; width:1px; height:1px; overflow:hidden; }
.rq-consent { display:flex; gap:.6rem; align-items:flex-start; font-size:.88rem; color:#3d4a56;
  margin:1rem 0; cursor:pointer; }
.rq-consent input { flex:0 0 auto; width:1.05rem; height:1.05rem; margin-top:.2rem; }
.rq-msg { margin-top:.6rem; font-size:.95rem; }
.rq-closed { padding-left:1.1rem; }
.rq-closed .rq-reason { color:#5b6876; }
.rq-privacy { font-size:.85rem; color:#5b6876; margin-top:2rem; }
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  // While api is empty the page runs in preview mode.
  var CONFIG = {
    api: "https://reader-questions.mithrilmetrics.workers.dev",
    sitekey: "0x4AAAAAAGQkNKE7zDFgzGsf"   // Turnstile site key (public)
  };
  var LIVE = CONFIG.api !== "" && CONFIG.sitekey !== "";

  var sampleReaders = [
    { id: "R-EX1", title: "Do farms in drought-prone regions of Brazil use more irrigation per tonne of soy?", region: "Latin America", days_listed: 76, list_days: 90 },
    { id: "R-EX2", title: "Has the gap between rice farm-gate and retail prices in the Philippines widened since 2020?", region: "Southeast Asia", days_listed: 12, list_days: 90 }
  ];
  var sampleClosed = [];
  var ourClosed = [];

  var rows = [];
  var votes = {};
  var voted = {};
  var filter = "all";
  try { voted = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("rq-voted") || "{}"); } catch (e) { voted = {}; }

  var msg = document.getElementById("rq-msg");
  var voteMsg = document.getElementById("rq-vote-msg");

  // ---- spam check: one Turnstile widget for the whole page ----
  // It runs on page load; each vote or question uses one token, then the widget fetches a new one.
  // If Cloudflare needs a click, the widget appears just below the table.
  var widgetId = null;
  var token = null;
  var waiting = [];
  function giveToken(t) {
    token = t;
    while (token && waiting.length) {
      var w = waiting.shift();
      clearTimeout(w.timer);
      var use = token;
      token = null;
      w.resolve(use);
    }
  }
  function failWaiting(code) {
    while (waiting.length) {
      var w = waiting.shift();
      clearTimeout(w.timer);
      w.reject(new Error(code));
    }
  }
  function startTurnstile() {
    var tries = 0;
    (function wait() {
      if (window.turnstile) {
        widgetId = window.turnstile.render("#rq-check", {
          sitekey: CONFIG.sitekey,
          appearance: "interaction-only",
          callback: giveToken,
          "expired-callback": function () { token = null; window.turnstile.reset(widgetId); },
          "error-callback": function (code) { token = null; failWaiting("captcha_" + code); return true; }
        });
        return;
      }
      if (++tries > 150) { failWaiting("captcha_not_loaded"); return; }
      setTimeout(wait, 100);
    })();
  }
  function getToken() {
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      if (token) { var t = token; token = null; resolve(t); return; }
      var w = { resolve: resolve, reject: reject };
      w.timer = setTimeout(function () {
        var i = waiting.indexOf(w);
        if (i >= 0) waiting.splice(i, 1);
        reject(new Error("captcha_timeout"));
      }, 20000);
      waiting.push(w);
    });
  }
  function usedToken() {
    if (widgetId !== null && window.turnstile) window.turnstile.reset(widgetId);
  }

  function post(path, body) {
    return fetch(CONFIG.api + path, {
      method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body)
    }).then(function (r) {
      return r.json().catch(function () { return {}; }).then(function (j) { return { status: r.status, body: j }; });
    });
  }

  // ---- table (all values inserted as text) ----
  function cell(tr, text, cls) {
    var td = document.createElement("td");
    td.textContent = text;
    if (cls) td.className = cls;
    tr.appendChild(td);
    return td;
  }
  function render() {
    var tbody = document.querySelector("#rq-all tbody");
    tbody.replaceChildren();
    var shown = rows.filter(function (r) { return filter === "all" || r.src === filter; });
    shown.sort(function (a, b) { return (votes[b.id] || 0) - (votes[a.id] || 0); });
    shown.forEach(function (r) {
      var tr = document.createElement("tr");
      cell(tr, r.title);
      cell(tr, r.region || "–", "rq-region");
      var s = cell(tr, "", "rq-src");
      var tag = document.createElement("span");
      tag.className = r.src;
      tag.textContent = r.src === "ours" ? "Ours" : "Reader";
      s.appendChild(tag);
      if (r.src === "reader") {
        var d = document.createElement("span");
        d.className = "rq-days";
        d.textContent = "day " + r.days_listed + " of " + r.list_days;
        s.appendChild(d);
      }
      cell(tr, String(votes[r.id] || 0), "rq-num");
      var vtd = cell(tr, "", "rq-vote");
      var b = document.createElement("button");
      b.type = "button";
      b.className = "btn btn-outline-primary";
      b.textContent = voted[r.id] ? "Voted" : "▲ Vote";
      b.disabled = !!voted[r.id];
      b.setAttribute("aria-label", "Vote for: " + r.title);
      b.addEventListener("click", function () { castVote(r.id, b); });
      vtd.appendChild(b);
      tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
    document.getElementById("rq-shown").textContent = shown.length + " question" + (shown.length === 1 ? "" : "s");
  }
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".rq-filter"), function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      filter = btn.getAttribute("data-src");
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".rq-filter"), function (o) {
        o.classList.toggle("active", o === btn);
      });
      render();
    });
  });
  function renderClosed(readerClosed) {
    var list = ourClosed.concat(readerClosed || [])
      .filter(function (c) { return c.note === "Answered" && c.link; })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return (b.date || "").localeCompare(a.date || ""); })
      .slice(0, 5);
    var ul = document.getElementById("rq-closed");
    ul.replaceChildren();
    list.forEach(function (c) {
      var li = document.createElement("li");
      li.appendChild(document.createTextNode(c.title + " "));
      var s = document.createElement("span");
      s.className = "rq-reason";
      s.textContent = "(" + c.note + ")";
      li.appendChild(s);
      if (c.link) {
        li.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" "));
        var a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = c.link;
        a.textContent = "Read it";
        li.appendChild(a);
      }
      ul.appendChild(li);
    });
    if (!list.length) {
      var li = document.createElement("li");
      li.textContent = "Nothing answered yet.";
      ul.appendChild(li);
    }
  }
  function markVoted(id) {
    voted[id] = true;
    try { localStorage.setItem("rq-voted", JSON.stringify(voted)); } catch (e) {}
  }

  function castVote(id, button) {
    voteMsg.textContent = "";
    if (!LIVE) {
      votes[id] = (votes[id] || 0) + 1;
      voted[id] = true;
      render();
      return;
    }
    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = "Sending";
    getToken().then(function (t) {
      return post("/api/vote", { id: id, token: t });
    }).then(function (res) {
      usedToken();
      if (res.status === 200) {
        if (res.body.counted) votes[id] = (votes[id] || 0) + 1;
        markVoted(id);
      } else if (res.status === 429) {
        voteMsg.textContent = "Vote limit for today reached. Thank you for taking part.";
      } else {
        voteMsg.textContent = "Sorry, the vote could not be counted (code: " + (res.body.error || res.status) + (res.body.detail ? ": " + res.body.detail : "") + ").";
      }
      render();
    }).catch(function (err) {
      usedToken();
      voteMsg.textContent = err.message === "captcha_timeout"
        ? "The spam check did not finish. If a check box appeared below the table, tick it and vote again."
        : "Sorry, the vote could not be sent (code: " + err.message + ").";
      render();
    });
  }

  // ---- submission ----
  var text = document.getElementById("rq-text");
  var count = document.getElementById("rq-count");
  var consent = document.getElementById("rq-consent");
  var sendBtn = document.getElementById("rq-send");
  text.addEventListener("input", function () { count.textContent = text.value.length; });
  consent.addEventListener("change", function () { sendBtn.disabled = !consent.checked; });
  function resetForm() {
    text.value = "";
    count.textContent = "0";
    consent.checked = false;
    sendBtn.disabled = true;
  }
  document.getElementById("rq-form").addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var v = text.value.trim();
    if (!consent.checked) { msg.textContent = "Please tick the consent box to send your question."; return; }
    if (v.length < 20) { msg.textContent = "Please write a full question (at least 20 characters)."; return; }
    if (/https?:|www\.|<|>/i.test(v)) { msg.textContent = "Please leave out links and angle brackets."; return; }
    var done = "Thank you, we have received your question. We read every question but cannot take up all of them; if we list it, it appears in the table above in our wording.";
    if (!LIVE) { msg.textContent = done + " (Preview: nothing was sent.)"; resetForm(); return; }
    sendBtn.disabled = true;
    msg.textContent = "Sending…";
    getToken().then(function (t) {
      return post("/api/submit", {
        text: v, region: document.getElementById("rq-region").value,
        website: document.getElementById("rq-website").value, token: t
      });
    }).then(function (res) {
      usedToken();
      if (res.status === 200) { msg.textContent = done; resetForm(); return; }
      if (res.body.error === "bad_text") msg.textContent = "Please check the question: 20–300 characters, no links.";
      else if (res.status === 429) msg.textContent = "Thank you, that is the limit of questions for today.";
      else msg.textContent = "Sorry, the question could not be sent (code: " + (res.body.error || res.status) + (res.body.detail ? ": " + res.body.detail : "") + ").";
      sendBtn.disabled = !consent.checked;
    }).catch(function (err) {
      usedToken();
      msg.textContent = err.message === "captcha_timeout"
        ? "The spam check did not finish. If a check box appeared below the question list, tick it and send again."
        : "Sorry, the question could not be sent (code: " + err.message + ").";
      sendBtn.disabled = !consent.checked;
    });
  });

  // ---- load data ----
  fetch("data/open_questions.json").then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (d) {
    var ours = (d.questions || []).map(function (q) { return { id: q.id, title: q.title, region: q.region, src: "ours" }; });
    ourClosed = d.closed || [];
    if (!LIVE) {
      rows = ours.concat(sampleReaders.map(function (r) { r.src = "reader"; return r; }));
      render();
      renderClosed(sampleClosed);
      return;
    }
    document.getElementById("rq-banner").hidden = true;
    startTurnstile();
    return fetch(CONFIG.api + "/api/public").then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (p) {
      votes = p.votes || {};
      rows = ours.concat((p.readers || []).map(function (r) {
        return { id: r.id, title: r.title, region: r.region, src: "reader", days_listed: r.days_listed, list_days: r.list_days };
      }));
      render();
      renderClosed(p.closed || []);
    });
  }).catch(function () {
    render();
    voteMsg.textContent = "The question list could not be loaded. Please try again later.";
  });
})();
</script>
```
